why: Third resume of the stirred-core validation toward the end of central hydrogen (evolve4-25c: 4.0 M_Ch at Xc 0.009, 2.5 M_Ch at 0.12, dX 0.01). Books within 1.2% except one 3-model transient at 2.5 M_Ch (peak 25%) where its convective core regrows 2% to 8% and mixes in fresh hydrogen (Xc 0.164 to 0.208), back to 1.0003 within 5 models; dX 0.005 within 0.27% in time. The final ladder rerun launches once both reach Xc 1e-3.
